caption: The video captures a close-up view of a sunset sky filled with layered clouds, with no sun disk, horizon, or ground visible. A bright orange glow dominates the upper-left, while a diagonal band of lit cloud runs from the top-center down toward the lower-right. Darker purple and mauve cloud banks occupy the right side and lower-middle, with thin orange wisps glowing through gaps near the bottom. The cloud formations drift and morph very slowly, with only slight changes from one moment to the next. The orange patch in the upper-left gradually softens as its boundary with the purple sky shifts inward. The illuminated diagonal band subtly changes shape and brightness, and the dark purple mass along the right edge creeps a little leftward. Overall the color balance deepens toward purple on the right while the orange at the lower-center keeps glowing.
relations: Upper-left orange glow softens and boundary shifts inward toward purple sky.
Right-edge dark purple cloud mass creeps leftward, deepening color balance.
Illuminated diagonal cloud band subtly changes shape and brightness while drifting slowly.
Thin orange wisps continue glowing through lower gaps as cloud formations morph.
